clue.text: One providing better information from starting price

indicators.note: the answer is made from a reworking of the two words that follow, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone whose superior knowledge derives from the starting price quoted at the races.
explanation.walkthrough: 'better' is a pun: a bettor is a gambler. The letters of STARTING PRICE are rearranged, signalled by 'from'.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing tipster gives punters advice on which horse to back, information for those who bet.

clue.text: Girl able to set up a whole lot of dates

clue.text: Concerning the content of certain records

clue.text: Dashing chap with exotic tan on cheek
